facts.fact: The Directorate for the Modernisation of Administrative Organisation (DMOA) enrolled the mayor of Marcory and the municipality's secretary-general into the public administration electronic signature system on 15 September 2026, with ANSSI present to validate the enrolments.
facts.system: electronic signature system for public administration

facts.fact: The DMOA says it is expanding electronic signature use across public administration, now reaching municipal officials in Marcory with support from the DGDDL and ANSSI.
